title: Derive reserved MSBuildProjectExtension from the shared root project context
outcome: Both language adapters derive MSBuildProjectExtension from the actual root project path before imports, independent of SDK and TFM, without using the current imported file extension.
acceptance: A failing-before/passing-after regression evaluates the screenshot condition '$(MSBuildProjectExtension)' == '.fsproj' in the project body and early/imported props, including SDK-less projects.
C# and F# use one reserved-property rule from their real project path; later or imported assignments cannot silently replace this reserved property.
Cold/delta Exists capture converges under extension-dependent conditions; schema, capabilities, version, full gates and dual review reflect changed behavior.

completion.summary: Shared reserved MSBuildProjectExtension derives from the real root project path before early imports for C# and F#, independent of SDK or TFM.
